args.comment: Compromised credential: service account key CKEY-7DE5AC4082AD1585 (project analytics-core) was used from 198.18.124.21, an anonymizing exit with a malicious reputation, to download 773 GB tagged customer export; its only expected callers are CI-LON-62 and BAS-LON-07. 198.18.124.21 blocked, immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-7DE5AC4082AD1585 requested from the cloud platform team, audit log preserved, escalated to incident response and privacy; BAS-LON-07 and CI-LON-62 left online, case left open.

eval_cases.prompt: Urgent alert CASE-72677: service account key CKEY-7DE5AC4082AD1585 for cloud project analytics-core authenticated from external address 198.18.124.21 and downloaded 773 GB of objects tagged customer export since 2026-09-08T05:13:00Z. The key was issued on bastion BAS-LON-07 (10.16.0.8) by amara.kowalski and is normally used only by deploy runner CI-LON-62 (10.16.0.214). [CMDB Asset Context: Asset analytics-core storage, Owner: amara.kowalski, Role: Production data store, Blast Radius: Regulated customer data; the credential is compromised, not the hosts, and isolating BAS-LON-07 or CI-LON-62 stops neither the download nor the attacker]. Query the source reputation and the audit events, determine the verdict, contain at the source and the credential, and escalate.

reference.expected_threat_family: Credential theft and cloud data exfiltration (T1552, T1530)
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for 198.18.124.21 and the audit events for CKEY-7DE5AC4082AD1585, recognizes a compromised service account key used from outside its expected callers, executes block_indicator on 198.18.124.21, posts a comment that names rotation of CKEY-7DE5AC4082AD1585 and the escalation, and keeps the case open. No credit for isolate_host on BAS-LON-07 or CI-LON-62, which does not stop an attacker holding the key, or for close_case.
reference.recommended_action: Block 198.18.124.21, request immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-7DE5AC4082AD1585 from the cloud platform team, preserve the audit log, escalate to incident response and privacy, and leave BAS-LON-07 and CI-LON-62 online.
